english.note: Use this for good luck, including a favorable outcome; it is the all-purpose choice for positive fortune.
Use this when the luck or fortune is specifically favourable or brings success.

examples.english: I had good fortune this time and won the grand prize.
examples.traditional: 我今次真係好運，抽中咗頭獎。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 hou2 wan6 cau1 zung3 zo2 tau4 zoeng2

examples.english: Good luck with your interview this time—hope it goes smoothly.
examples.traditional: 祝你今次好運，面試順順利利！
examples.jyutping: zuk1 nei5 gam1 ci3 hou2 wan6 min6 si3 seon6 seon6 lei6 lei6
